text:
maria: Question for the group — we're trying to standardize how we map internal route/fallback signals to client-facing responses. Right now some SDKs surface raw internal codes (e.g. ROUTE_BACKPRESSURE) which is confusing. Thoughts on a single 'reason' field vs separate 'surface_code' + 'internal_code'?
aj: +1 on reducing leak of internal names. 'reason' is nice but we also need structured hints for retry semantics.
maria: Agree. We want human-friendly but machine-usable. Proposed shape:
```json
{
  "status": 503,
  "surface_code": "service_unavailable",
  "reason": "capacity_constrained - try again in 1000ms",
  "retry_after_ms": 1000
}
```
kevin: I like the retry_after_ms field. But warning: for some fallbacks we return an alternate model (like smaller quantized) — we might want a 'fallback_variant' hint, not just retry.
sarah: +1. Also console UX wants categories for dashboards: 'transient', 'quota', 'degraded', 'terminal'. Can we standardize those tags?
aj: category tags are good. But telemetry needs a stable enum for downstream aggregation. Proposed list: [transient, quota, capacity, degraded, auth, client_error, unknown].
maria: That covers most. We need mapping rules: internal routing reasons -> surface_code + category + optional hints. Let's add an opt-in internal_code only visible to org admins in the console (audit logs), not to public API.
kevin: How about this mapping rule example: ROUTE_BACKPRESSURE -> surface_code=service_unavailable, category=capacity, retry_after_ms=calc_from_queue. But on dedicated customers we may expose 'fallback_variant' when allowed by policy.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new schema proposal uploaded: https://redwood-internal/docs/error-mapping/v2 (uploaded by maria) :thumbsup:
sarah: UX note: console should show aggregated counts by surface_code and top 3 internal reasons per org if admin enabled. That will help debugging without exposing internals by default.
maria: Edge case: quota applies at both tenant and route. For tenant quota breaches we want surface_code=quota_exceeded, category=quota, and include 'next_reset_ts' if it's a rate window.
aj: One more: SDKs should present a consistent retry decision API. Example JS SDK: error.retryable (bool), error.retryAfterMs (number|null), error.fallbackVariant (string|null), error.surfaceCode (string).
kevin: We should add a short lint rule to server side to prevent raw internal_code from reaching public responses. CI check before rollout.
maria: Plan: I will draft an RFC with schema + mapping table + examples for the console and SDK surfaces. Will include rollout plan: server-side reject any public response that has internal_code unless org-admin-allowed flag set. Target doc by EOW.
sarah: Thanks — can you include a couple of sample console panels (how aggregated tags look) in the RFC? It's what product will need for acceptance tests.
maria: Yep. I'll ping once uploaded. If anyone has urgent objections speak now.
aj: No objections from me.
kevin: Fine from infra side.
sarah: Good to go.
maria: Thanks all.
